title: Your Apple Watch calorie tracker is an educated guess, not a fact - Engadget
summary: While the best smartwatches and fitness trackers are capable of providing accurate heart rate measurements, calorie expenditure involves far more variables, making it hard for wearables to provide calorie tracking you can rely upon.
